description: The original official store for Vue 2/3, now in maintenance mode. Uses state, getters, mutations, actions and modules.
Vuex-only synchronous function that changes state, triggered with `commit`. Pinia has no mutations.
String-based calls to Vuex actions and mutations, e.g. `store.dispatch('cart/checkout')`.
A Vuex sub-store with `namespaced: true`, addressed with `module/name` strings. In Pinia each store is already separate.
